facts.note: The hub is a hall at its lower bound, and it is the only place in the circuit a body sees twice: once on arrival and once through the hole in the ceiling of the world above it. Sixteen blocks is what makes the fall land somewhere a walker recognises.

The depth of the long gallery, and the only number in the design that decides the pitch of the climb out of it. Ten blocks of run buys the gentle standard; anything under that and the derivation has to spend the rise on a steeper one.
One plane for the whole upper circuit — the walk, the vault and the lip. A single datum is what makes the hole home a fall of exactly the policy cap rather than a number nobody chose.
